test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The selling price of an article is (4)/(3) times of its cost price. The gain percentage is:
solution:
Given:

The selling price of an article is 4/3 times its cost price.

Given Data:

Selling Price = 4/3 × Cost Price

Concept: Gain percentage = [(Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price] * 100%

Calculation:

Gain = Selling Price - Cost Price = 4/3 × Cost Price - Cost Price = 1/3 × Cost Price

Gain percentage = [(1/3 × Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100% = **33.33%**
